report.name: three ordered stages; table preset updates the current scene
changing A to B updates the framing draft and the actual camera; no duplicate shots or actor changes
undo restores the previous camera framing
stationary follow applies actor and camera travel together, rendered camera frames visibly change
blocking edits the selected actor only and preserves the camera and the other actor route
AI camera planning and scene editing live under the correct step, without triggering a model
